items.title: Suno lanza un nuevo modelo de IA para música tras múltiples demandas por derechos de autor
The Sony and Warner music publishers finally get round to suing Anthropic
items.summary: The Sony and Warner music publishing companies are the latest publishers to sue AI firm Anthropic for copyright infringement. They also name Anthropic founders Ben Mann and Dario Amodei as defendants, arguing they were personally involved in the illegal downloading of pirated sheet music and lyrics

items.title: Latest Suno lawsuit accuses AI company of violating the publicity rights of musicians rather than infringing their copyrights
items.summary: Suno is facing another lawsuit from the music industry. But this time it’s not a copyright lawsuit. A group of musicians claim Suno has violated their US publicity rights by “encoding musicians’ identities into its AI model” and then “exploiting those identities by publicly using musicians’ names”

items.title: Donald Trump’s DoJ says OpenAI should be able to do whatever it wants with copyright protected works
items.summary: The US Department Of Justice has intervened in a legal battle between the New York Times and OpenAI, arguing that AI training is ‘fair use’ under American copyright law. Whether or not AI training is fair use is at the centre of dozens of AI lawsuits, including those filed by the music industry

items.title: Udio Fires Back Against Supersized Sony Music Suit, Emphasizing Its Fair Use Defense and Acknowledging ‘That It Acquired Some of Its Training Data by Utilizing YT-DLP’
items.summary: Udio has fired back against Sony Music’s supersized copyright suit – including by doubling down on its fair use argument and by accusing the major of engaging “in anticompetitive activities that extend an unlawful monopoly over the production and commercialization of music.” The AI music platform just recently offered…

items.title: Adult Film Producer Unmasks Prolific ‘John Doe’ Torrent Pirate as Meta Executive
items.summary: A routine John Doe lawsuit could become part of Strike 3 Holdings' $446 million AI training case against Meta. tip.title: Guarda los proyectos, no solo el master
tip.body: En una disputa de autoría, el archivo de sesión de tu DAW con fecha, stems y versiones intermedias pesa más que el WAV final. Respalda el proyecto completo, no nada más el bounce.

tip.title: Keep the project files, not just the master
tip.body: In an authorship dispute, your dated DAW session with stems and work-in-progress versions carries more weight than the final WAV. Back up the whole project, not just the bounce.
